Esri to Debut the Power of Where Collection at 2026 Esri User Conference

📅 2026-07-14 ✍️ Esri 🏷️ Esri, Power of Where, GIS, Jack Dangermond, Geowater, Parcels, Esri Press, Esri User Conference 2026
🔗 Read the source article →

💡 Quick summary

Esri announced the Power of Where Collection, a new series of books expanding on Jack Dangermond's foundational GIS philosophy, debuting at the 2026 Esri User Conference with titles on water data and property geography.

📌 Key takeaways

  • The Power of Where Collection builds on Jack Dangermond's 2024 book exploring GIS as a framework for solving global challenges
  • First two titles: "Geowater: A Geographic Approach to Water Data and Forecasting" and "Parcels: How Property Shapes Geography"
  • The collection demonstrates how spatial thinking and GIS are transforming resource management and governance
  • Books will be featured at the 2026 Esri User Conference through author presentations and book signings
  • Future titles will expand the collection to additional industries and disciplines
